title: Kramer 50th Anniversary Pacer Carrera, Anniversary Gold

long_description.title: Celebrating the 50th anniversary of the world’s hardest-rockin’ guitar brand
long_description.body:
Kramer is turning 50, so naturally, we’re cranking things up to 11! In honor of five decades of boundary-pushing tone and iconic design, we’re unleashing a special limited-edition series of some of our most popular models, each finished in glossy metallic Anniversary Gold. These guitars defined an era and continue to inspire generations of players. Each model is limited to this anniversary year, making them a must-have for collectors and players alike. 

The 50th Anniversary Pacer Carrera delivers cutting-edge speed and performance, with a double-cutaway maple body with forearm and body comfort carves that make it comfortable to play all night. The bolt-on maple neck is fastened to the body with a Kramer four-bolt neck plate, and has a fast-playing natural satin finish and a shred-ready Slim profile. The ebony fretboard features white side dot position markers, but no fretboard inlays, giving it a sleek appearance. 

The headstock features the classic Kramer “beak” profile. It is outfitted with a Floyd Rose® R2 locking nut, black premium die-cast tuners, a black string retaining bar, and a matching black wrench holder on the rear so you’ll always have the tools available for quick adjustments and string changes. The headstock is also finished in Anniversary Gold to match the body. The Floyd Rose 1000 Series tremolo delivers unmatched tuning stability, regardless of how hard or often you work the vibrato bar. 

The pickups are a pair of Kramer Eruption PRO™ humbuckers™ wired to a master volume control, individual tone controls for each pickup, and a 3-way mini toggle pickup selector switch. The black, knurled metal knobs fit in perfectly with the rest of the all-black hardware and deliver a firm grip, no matter how hot and sweaty the action gets onstage.  

The 50th Anniversary Pacer Carrera comes packed in a Kramer premium gig bag, so it’s ready to join you on all of your musical adventures. This is more than a guitar—it is a collector’s dream with premium components and a piece of rock history, and will only be available during this anniversary year. Don’t miss your chance to own a legend, reborn for Kramer’s 50th Anniversary.
